name: Etsy API
description: Exposes the Etsy API to integrate an Etsy shop with a Drupal site.
project_description:
Etsy* is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods with millions of shops run by hobbiest, entrepreneurs and others. This module was designed to allow shop owners to integrate their Etsy shop with their Drupal website.

 This module suite has be rewritten from the ground up for Drupal 9 and 10 using v3 of the Etsy API and contains two main modules; Etsy API and Etsy Shop. Other modules are encouraged to require either or both of these moudles as a dependency to

implement shop features that you need for your site.

 The Etsy API module provides a service wrapper to the Etsy API and is designed to integrate a single Etsy shop. The Etsy Shop module is used as a base or example implementation for an Etsy Shop in Drupal.

 Requirements 

 
 Imagecache External 
 OAuth2 Client 
 
 Recommended modules 

 
 Pathauto 
 Metatag 
 
 Known Issues 

 See the module README.md file for current known issues and workarounds.

 * The term 'Etsy' is a trademark of Etsy, Inc. This module uses the Etsy API but is not endorsed or certified by Etsy.
